usedFor: Aircall holds your phone contacts, and Teamhood receives a board item when “New Contact” runs “Create Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Aircall, then “Create Item” in Teamhood
bestTemplate.why: A new Aircall contact becomes a Teamhood board item, ready for follow-up.

watchOut: “Create Item” adds to one Teamhood board, so choose the board your team actually watches.
